dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.ide.getEditorDescriptor.modernize>
<!description: Replace IDE.getEditorDescriptor(IFile) with IDE.getEditorDescriptor(IFile, boolean, boolean) for more explicit behavior and to address deprecation (if applicable).>
<!severity: WARNING>

org.eclipse.ui.ide.IDE.getEditorDescriptor($file)
=>
org.eclipse.ui.ide.IDE.getEditorDescriptor($file, true, true)
;;
summary: Replaces the `IDE.getEditorDescriptor(IFile)` method call with `IDE.getEditorDescriptor(IFile, boolean, boolean)` using `true` for both additional boolean parameters, aligning with a more explicit or modernized API usage.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
